item.title: [Feature] Contextual Ask AI (inline Q&A from selection)
item.body: ### 💡 Feature Request: Contextual “Ask AI” (Inline / One-click Q&A from selected content) Hi TRAE team, First of all, thank you for building such a powerful AI coding IDE. TRAE already provides strong capabilities with inline chat and code understanding, but I’d like to suggest a feature that could significantly improve UX and workflow speed. --- ## 🚀 Feature idea Introduce a **contextual “Ask AI” action** that allows users to: * Select any text (code, logs, docs, error messages) * Right-click or click a floating button → **“Ask TRAE”** * Instantly open an AI query using that selection as context (without manual copy-paste) * Image example : --- ## 🎯 Why this matters Currently, even though TRAE has an AI assistant, the flow is still: 1. Copy content 2. Open chat 3. Paste 4. Ask question This adds friction, especially during debugging or reading unfamiliar code. A contextual “Ask AI” would: * Reduce interaction cost (fewer steps) * Improve developer flow state * Make TRAE feel more like a true **AI copilot** --- ## 🧠 Suggested implementation Conceptually, this is a **context-aware query system** (similar to “Ask ChatGPT” in some UIs): * Inject selected content into the prompt automatically * Optionally include: * file path * surrounding code * project context (if available) Example prompt: > “Explain / debug / optimize this code: [selected snippet]” --- ## ✨ Possible extensions * Quick actions: * “Explain this” * “Fix bug” * “Refactor” * “Add comments” * Keyboard shortcut (e.g. Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + Enter) * Works in: * editor * terminal output * logs panel --- ## 🧩 Why it fits TRAE TRAE is positioned as an **AI-powered coding partner** ([[TraeIDE](https://traeide.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)][1]), so reducing friction between “seeing something” → “asking AI about it” would be a huge UX win. This feature is already becoming standard in next-gen AI IDEs, and implementing it would help TRAE stay competitive. --- ## 🙌 Summary A lightweight but high-impact feature: 👉 Turn any selected content into an instant AI query 👉 No copy-paste needed 👉 Faster, more natural developer workflow --- Thanks for considering this idea! Happy to provide mockups or further details if needed. [1]: https://traeide.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com "TraeIDE"
